description: Operate and troubleshoot a user-managed OmniRoute AI gateway using its documented APIs and MCP features.

defaultPrompt: Help me set up or troubleshoot my OmniRoute gateway safely.
Explain how to connect a coding agent to my OmniRoute instance.
Help diagnose an OmniRoute provider, model, or MCP connection issue.
interface.longDescription: Guides setup, safe configuration, provider and model diagnostics, MCP connectivity, quota-aware routing, and troubleshooting for an OmniRoute instance you run or control. This package provides instructions and does not itself host OmniRoute or know your local gateway address.

name: omniroute-operator
